# EzzySync

EzzySync is a modern, AI-powered travel CRM designed specifically for travel agencies and independent travel advisors. It helps travel professionals manage their entire lead pipeline, automate client follow-ups via WhatsApp (using the official Meta Cloud API), track bookings, manage invoices, and calculate profitability without switching between multiple disorganized tools.

## Key Links
- Homepage: https://www.ezzysync.com/
- Features: https://www.ezzysync.com/#features
- Pricing: https://www.ezzysync.com/pricing (Markdown version: https://www.ezzysync.com/pricing.md)
- About: https://www.ezzysync.com/about
- Blog: https://www.ezzysync.com/blog

## Core Capabilities
- **Lead Pipeline Management**: Visual Kanban board to track incoming travel inquiries from "New" to "Won".
- **WhatsApp Automation**: Direct integration with the Meta Cloud API for sending automated follow-ups, payment reminders, and itinerary updates to clients without unauthorized third-party extensions.
- **AI Itinerary Builder**: (Upcoming/Beta) Generate personalized day-by-day travel itineraries based on client preferences in seconds.
- **PDF Invoicing & Finance Tracking**: Generate professional invoices, track B2B supplier costs, and automatically calculate net profit margins per booking.
- **Multi-Tenant Isolation**: Secure data isolation so every travel agency's client data and financial records are completely private.
- **Team Management**: Role-based access control (Admin/Staff) with granular permissions for editing leads, downloading invoices, or exporting data.
